title: storytold/cadcraft
why_read: A third entry in the same clean-room Office/CAD suite, this time cloning AutoCAD-style functionality in Rust, continuing an ambitious but unverified pattern.
analysis: CADCraft is described as an open-source CAD and drafting application built in Rust, aiming to replicate AutoCAD-style workflows. CAD software involves complex geometric modeling, precision math, and often proprietary file format support, making this a technically demanding project if it delivers real functionality. Given it's part of the same 'storytold' family as the Word and Excel clones, it's worth noting as a pattern of ambitious clean-room reimplementations, though real-world usability remains unverified from the description.
